title: DNMT1 is associated with anti-PD-1 resistance and regulates the STAT3/PD-L1-CD8T-cell axis in melanoma.
snippet: Transcriptomic analysis of melanoma (MM) patients receiving anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (anti-PD-1) blockade identified differentially expressed genes and co-expression modules associated with therapeutic response.
